title: ML Fundamentals
description: Core machine learning algorithms, deep neural network mechanisms, and evaluation metrics.

cards.title: Gradient Descent & Backprop
cards.summary: First-order iterative optimization algorithm for finding a local minimum of a differentiable objective function using the chain rule.
cards.mnemonic: Walk down the slope of steepest decline; chain rule propagates errors back to every weight.
acceptedAnswers: Iteratively updates model parameters in the direction of negative gradient of the loss, using chain rule backpropagation.
Optimization technique computing gradients of the objective function with respect to parameters to minimize prediction error.
cards.hint: Think of hiking down a foggy mountain following the steepest slope, using derivatives to update weights.

cards.title: Overfitting & Regularization
cards.summary: When a statistical model memorizes training noise instead of generalizable patterns; mitigated by Dropout, L1 Lasso, and L2 Ridge.
cards.mnemonic: High train accuracy, low test accuracy: penalize complexity with L1/L2 weights and Dropout.
acceptedAnswers: Overfitting happens when a model learns training noise; solved by L1/L2 penalties, dropout, data augmentation, or early stopping.
High variance failure where model fits training data closely but fails on unseen validation sets, corrected by regularization.
cards.hint: High training score but poor validation performance; fixed by weight decay, L1/L2 penalties, or dropout.

cards.title: Transformer Self-Attention
cards.summary: Mechanism computing dynamic token-to-token compatibility weights using Query, Key, and Value dot products scaled by square root of head dimension.
cards.mnemonic: Softmax of (Q * K-transpose / sqrt(d_k)) multiplied by V: Queries seek matching Keys to blend Values.
acceptedAnswers: Computes scaled dot products between queries and keys, applies softmax to get attention weights, and computes weighted sum over values.
Attention formula: softmax of Q times K transpose divided by square root of d_k, multiplied by V.
cards.hint: The formula involves Q, K, and V: Softmax(Q K^T / sqrt(d_k)) * V.

cards.title: Cross-Entropy Loss
cards.summary: Measures performance of a classification model whose output is a probability distribution between 0 and 1 against true one-hot targets.
cards.mnemonic: -Sum(y_true * log(y_pred)): Harshly penalizes confident wrong predictions.
acceptedAnswers: Negative log likelihood of the true class probability, penalizing overconfident incorrect predictions logarithmically.
Loss function for classification computing the negative sum of true labels multiplied by log predicted probabilities.
cards.hint: Negative sum of y_true * log(y_pred); severely penalizes confident wrong classifications.

cards.title: Precision vs Recall & F1
cards.summary: Precision is TP/(TP+FP) measuring accuracy of positive calls; Recall is TP/(TP+FN) measuring coverage of actual positives; F1 is harmonic mean.
cards.mnemonic: Precision: Quality of positive calls. Recall: Quantity of actual targets caught. F1: Harmonic balance.
acceptedAnswers: Precision is true positives over total predicted positives; Recall is true positives over all actual positives; F1 balances both via harmonic mean.
Precision measures positive predictive value, Recall measures sensitivity or coverage, and F1 is their harmonic mean.
